resolutions.context: Price rejects a priori any evidence upon which a positive answer could be given

resolutions.context: Price rejects a priori any evidence upon which a positive answer could be given
resolutions.rationale: White overstates Price’s position, but he offers an argument for that characterization rather than assuming the debated conclusion inside a premise.

resolutions.context: the gospels are divinely inspired and thus accurate that I believe is the controlling assumption

resolutions.context: the Miracles that take place are consistent with the message of the New Testament itself

resolutions.context: the Miracles that take place are consistent with the message of the New Testament itself
resolutions.rationale: White treats internal consistency as favorable evidence for Christian miracles without stating an equivalent independent test applicable to rival supernatural traditions.

resolutions.context: historians can only trace and weigh human activities and events

resolutions.context: the only way you can define truth is by its internal consistency
resolutions.rationale: White wrongly makes coherence sufficient for truth, but the source does not show him shifting a key term between two meanings during one inference.

resolutions.context: the further back you go everything has to be held open

resolutions.context: someone's idea of what the apostles would have done is mere speculation

resolutions.context: kicking against the goads was a standard term with at least four prior uses

resolutions.context: it might be sheer accident that we do not but no evidence is no evidence

resolutions.context: every recitation is a new performance and it is meaningless to seek after an original
resolutions.rationale: Price transfers conclusions about long Balkan epic performances to shorter Jesus traditions without proportionately addressing differences in length, function, and community control.

resolutions.context: Price's view is incapable of demonstration or defense and it is theoretical
resolutions.rationale: Calling a theory undemonstrated is criticism of its support, not by itself treating the theory as false solely because it has not been proved.

resolutions.context: I see no inconsistency at all in the cosmopolitan character of Judaism
resolutions.rationale: Price uses cultural evidence to argue that mixed sources were possible, not absence of disproof to establish that literary dependence actually occurred.

resolutions.context: how in the world could you convince monotheistic Jews to adopt this pagan mythology
resolutions.rationale: White’s incredulity that monotheistic Jews would accept pagan-shaped material substitutes intuitive implausibility for establishing how the proposed borrowing inference fails.

resolutions.context: it would sure explain an awful lot if the text had been interpolated
resolutions.rationale: Price foregrounds selected tensions favoring interpolation while dismissing contextual reconciliation as harmonization without comparably testing those alternative readings passage by passage.

resolutions.context: we do not always know what the context was of every New Testament book

resolutions.context: the conversion of Paul just screams literary origin and the sources are amazingly similar
resolutions.rationale: Price’s language makes the conclusion feel obvious from resemblance without presenting enough distinctive ordered correspondences for literary dependence to follow.

resolutions.context: the sources that I point to are amazingly similar
resolutions.rationale: Price emphasizes selected similarities and Pauline silence while giving narrative differences, conventional motifs, and independent development noticeably less testing.

resolutions.context: why forge something in the name of someone who had left no mark

resolutions.context: it is just speculation and an interesting thought experiment

resolutions.context: Justin Martyr never mentions him and there are no known Paulinist Christians until later groups

resolutions.context: Paul had little control over the distortion of his own teaching during his own career

resolutions.context: the papyri contain the most variants and demonstrate there was never a standardization
resolutions.rationale: White appeals to positive early textual diversity against centralized standardization; the inference may be overconfident, but it is not based merely on ignorance.

resolutions.context: it is filled with internal indications that it is late material

resolutions.context: how could streams reflecting the older text be completely lost to history

resolutions.context: there is no reason to think this is a post crucifixion concept

resolutions.context: people are quick to misinterpret what they hear filtering it through expectations and biases
